new_activation_cases_added: acceptance close cannot be reused as post-acceptance displacement
target confirmed only on activation excluded as future information
activation delay exactly one completed minute
adapter delegates only after accepted activation validation
adapter records and rejects a pre-consumed target
adapter sizes with exchange-rounded stop and target

implementation_errors.failure: the signal builder tested delivery fraction and cost-after reward/risk at the decision close, while the inherited execution adapter sized and entered at the later activation close
implementation_errors.fix: repeat structural geometry, boundary, delivery-fraction and cost-after-RR checks at the actual activation close before order submission
implementation_errors.name: decision_price_only_economic_validation

implementation_errors.failure: the activation bar's OHLC path had already elapsed before on_bar submitted the order, but only close geometry was checked
implementation_errors.fix: reject when the activation bar already traversed the structural stop, natural target, or both
implementation_errors.name: activation_bar_pretraversal

implementation_errors.failure: target expiry was checked only at the decision timestamp and the first attempted repair then allowed eligibility to occur on the future activation bar
implementation_errors.fix: require eligibility no later than the decision close, require predetermined expiry through activation, and verify both again in the execution adapter
implementation_errors.name: target_activity_at_decision_not_activation

implementation_errors.failure: configuration allowed delays longer than one minute although the adapter did not track target/stop traversal in intervening bars
implementation_errors.fix: lock v104 activation delay to exactly one completed minute
implementation_errors.name: unobserved_multibar_activation_gap

implementation_errors.failure: the final common-acceptance candle could also satisfy the displacement state even though the locked state machine required acceptance to precede displacement
implementation_errors.fix: begin the exact displacement search on the first completed minute after the acceptance close
implementation_errors.name: acceptance_close_reused_as_post_acceptance_displacement

implementation_errors.failure: offline registry filtering allowed a target whose eligibility timestamp was the later activation close, while the signal claimed the prior decision close as its maximum market information
implementation_errors.fix: require target eligibility no later than decision_ns and require its predetermined expiry to cover activation_ns
implementation_errors.name: target_confirmed_on_activation_future_information

implementation_errors.failure: an activation bar could wick through the old-range invalidation but survive a wider protective stop and still be submitted
implementation_errors.fix: carry the distinct old-range invalidation into the activation contract and reject any completed activation bar which traversed it
implementation_errors.name: activation_structural_invalidation_not_enforced

implementation_errors.failure: the inherited adapter sized against unrounded stop and target floats, then converted prices to the instrument increment only when creating orders
implementation_errors.fix: convert stop and target to executable instrument prices before activation RR validation and current-NAV planned-loss sizing
implementation_errors.name: exchange_tick_rounding_after_risk_sizing

implementation_errors.failure: the prospective driver reused v53 execution/risk and v75/v89 data transformation files without verifying every exact Git blob
implementation_errors.fix: add all reused dependencies to source_files/source_git_blob_sha and verify them before collection
implementation_errors.name: reused_dependency_blobs_not_fully_locked
